opening.argument: The video opens by introducing a series on psychology and identifies the first episode’s subject as the past. The discussion then distinguishes what happens to a person from their interpretation of it. Even when addressing a hypothetical childhood-abuse experience, the speaker says the harm should not be dismissed as merely a story. These are parts of a discussion about past experiences and coping, not evidence of a deceptive offer. The end screen asks viewers to subscribe and promotes free registration for a live session, but the supplied material establishes no deceptive condition or harmful outcome from either request.
